summary: QuickType suggestion availability and visible letter motion after signed v1.0.206. New source requires exact-SHA Android CI and original-signed Obtainium verification before release.

changes.title: First-keystroke QuickType availability and stable word animation
changes.detail: Prepare next-word predictions when eligible text fields open; show an immediate, non-inserting literal-prefix fallback after the first key; deliver completed decoder results asynchronously only to the matching editor, request, text and cursor; refresh after dictionary loading; and reuse fixed three-slot suggestion views during ordinary updates. Keep all first-frame text fully opaque with native text-shaping fallbacks. Autocorrection at Space/Return retains a bounded freshness guard. No prediction ranking, BR Brain, voice, package, model, permissions, learning or signing change. Oppo hardware behavior remains to be confirmed by its owner.
